title: What's new in v2.3
items: Just like selecting tags per image, you're now also able to select performers per image!
Fixed an issue where for some scenes, no performer name/data could be scraped; resulting in a bugged performer selection.
Fixed an error that was popping up on fresh installs of the plugin. A folder was not available where the whole scraping system was built on. (fixed!)
Updated the UI of the tag selectior (per tag)
footer: Thank you for your support! If you have any ideas for future updates or if you found bugs, report them here: https://discourse.stashapp.cc/t/pornpics-importer/13625
